newsitem.title: USA: Computer Network Q1 off on sales softness.
newsitem.headline: Computer Network Q1 off on sales softness.

text.p: Computer Network Technology Corp said Thursday its earnings in the first quarter ended March 31 fell as a result of weakness in its base business and a partial cancellation of an order from IBM Corp for connectivity controllers.

The company reported net income of $376,519, or $0.02 a share, versus $19,148, or nil per share, in the same period one year ago. Total revenues fell to $21.7 million from $22.4 million in the first quarter of 1996.
Computer Network said IBM reevaluated its internal production schedules and Computer Network realized far less from IBM in terms of revenues than originally anticipated.
Computer Network also announced it will provide comprehensive disaster avoidance and business transaction recovery services as part of a strategic relationship with IBM.
The company makes computer networking products. Its shares closed unchanged Thursday at 5-1/4.
